elements.requirement: A person is guilty of blackmail if that person makes any unwarranted demand with menaces with a view to gain for himself or another, or with intent to cause loss to another.
elements.quote: guilty of blackmail if, with a view to gain for himself or another or with intent to cause loss to another, he makes any unwarranted demand with menaces

elements.requirement: A demand with menaces made by a person is unwarranted unless the person making it does so in the belief that he has reasonable grounds for making the demand and that the use of the menaces is a proper means of reinforcing the demand.
elements.quote: a demand with menaces is unwarranted unless the person making it does so in the belief— (a) that he has reasonable grounds for making the demand; and (b) that the use of the menaces is a proper means of reinforcing the demand

elements.requirement: In relation to blackmail, the nature of the act or omission demanded is immaterial.
elements.quote: The nature of the act or omission demanded is immaterial

elements.requirement: In relation to blackmail, it is immaterial whether the menaces relate to action to be taken by the person making the demand.
elements.quote: immaterial whether the menaces relate to action to be taken by the person making the demand

elements.requirement: A person guilty of blackmail is liable on conviction on indictment to imprisonment for a term not exceeding fourteen years.
elements.quote: on conviction on indictment be liable to imprisonment for a term not exceeding fourteen years

thresholds.what: maximum term of imprisonment on conviction on indictment for blackmail
